name: The Prisoner Wine Company - St. Helena CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driveway entrance off Galleron Road flanked by two decorative stone monument pillars; no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point across the lane. Open winery entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. Only a small white utility cabinet beside the lane and the two ornamental stone pillars.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from Galleron Road across a rail crossing, then up the west side of the property to the building/parking area — easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No row of dedicated freight dock doors. A small winery service/loading area on the NW (crush-pad) face of the production building shows roughly 2-4 service doors. Low confidence on exact count from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line (Napa Valley Wine Train corridor) runs along Galleron Road and the property driveway crosses it at grade, but no rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Napa Valley agricultural setting — winery surrounded entirely by vineyards near St. Helena, well outside any dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting, but St. Helena/Napa Valley is well-developed wine country with reasonable cellular coverage; marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single integrated winery building cluster plus a separate small structure to the north (treatment/equipment); treated as one campus, multipleFacilities false.

citations.claim: Constellation's retained portfolio explicitly names The Prisoner Wine Company
Official site publishes current tasting hours at 1178 Galleron Rd, St. Helena (active operation)

verification.rationale: On the June 2025 retained list; Galleron Rd production/tasting estate actively operating in 2026.
